source: sanosystems live pricing page, read at build time
how_to_say_these: Say dollar amounts in FULL words, never the short form — 'three hundred ninety-seven a month', never 'three ninety-seven' (it comes out as $3.97). Give ONE package unless they ask for more. Never round, never estimate, never a tier tour.

packages.name: Starter
packages.annual_spoken: four thousand seven hundred sixty-four a year, with the thirteenth month free
packages.usage: about $60 to $200 a month on top, its own line on the invoice
packages.includes: Every missed call and inbound text answered by text within seconds, around the clock. Online booking and reminders. Review requests after every job. Google listing kept sharp. Answers by text only — live voice starts at Growth.

packages.name: Growth
packages.setup_spoken: two thousand four hundred ninety-seven one-time setup
packages.annual_spoken: eleven thousand nine hundred eighty-eight a year, with the thirteenth month free
packages.usage: about $60 to $200 a month on top, its own line on the invoice
packages.includes: Everything in Starter, plus a real voice answering the phone — an AI that says so — with 500 talk-minutes a month, roughly 250 to 300 calls. Instagram and Facebook messages in the same inbox. An assistant on their website. Every quote and lead followed up until they get an answer. Customers brought back when they're due, win-backs, day-after check-ins. Email and text campaigns to their customer list. English and Spanish live voice. Hiring and team systems — hiring pipeline with licence checks, a training portal with quizzes, tryout scorecards, e-signed onboarding paperwork, simple inventory. The app on their phone.

packages.name: Scale
packages.monthly_spoken: one thousand nine hundred ninety-five a month
packages.setup_spoken: four thousand nine hundred ninety-seven one-time setup
packages.annual_spoken: twenty-three thousand nine hundred forty a year, with the thirteenth month free
packages.usage: usage is bundled into the plan
packages.includes: Everything in Growth, plus 2,000 talk-minutes, landing pages built and maintained, ads planned and managed, invoices and pay-by-text, and a monthly strategy call.

packages.name: Total Transformation
packages.monthly_spoken: four thousand nine hundred ninety-seven a month
packages.setup_spoken: fourteen thousand nine hundred ninety-seven one-time setup
packages.annual_spoken: fifty-nine thousand nine hundred sixty-four a year, with the thirteenth month free
packages.usage: usage is bundled into the plan
packages.includes: Everything in Scale, plus high usage limits named in the agreement, that same app carrying their own name and logo for them and their customers, a dedicated manager, weekly calls, a four-hour support response target, and multiple locations.

usage_note: Usage — texts, emails, call minutes, AI — typically $60 to $200 a month on Starter and Growth, and is bundled in on Scale and Total Transformation. Never billed for overage they haven't agreed to first.
annual_note: Pay twelve months up front and the thirteenth is free — about 8% off.
